## Team Directory

This page provides an overview of our PMX (Performance Metrics Excellence) team members. Our diverse team brings together expertise in data science, analytics, and domain-specific knowledge to deliver exceptional insights and solutions.

View the interactive directory below to explore team member information, roles, and key performance indicators.

## Team Members

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

# Connect to database
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../assets/data/site_data.db")

# Query employee data
people_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    employee_id,
    name,
    department,
    role,
    years_experience,
    projects_completed,
    active_projects,
    utilization,
    status
  FROM employees
  ORDER BY department, years_experience DESC
")

dbDisconnect(con)

# Calculate additional metrics
people_data <- people_data %>%
  mutate(
    Avg_Projects_Per_Year = round(projects_completed / years_experience, 1)
  )

# Create clickable name links pointing to employee profiles
people_data <- people_data %>%
  mutate(
    Name = paste0(
      '<a href="/qmd/employees/',
      employee_id,
      '.html" style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">',
      name,
      '</a>'
    ),
    Department = department,
    Role = role,
    Years_Experience = years_experience,
    Projects_Completed = projects_completed,
    Active_Projects = active_projects,
    Utilization = utilization,
    Status = status
  ) %>%
  select(Name, Department, Role, Years_Experience, Projects_Completed,
         Active_Projects, Avg_Projects_Per_Year, Utilization, Status)

# Create interactive table
datatable(people_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 12,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf')
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE,  # IMPORTANT: Allow HTML rendering for clickable links
          caption = "PMX Team Directory") %>%
  formatStyle('Status',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('High Load', 'Normal', 'Available'),
                c('#fff3cd', '#d1ecf1', '#d4edda')
              )) %>%
  formatStyle('Utilization',
              background = styleColorBar(c(0, 100), '#4b7874'),
              backgroundSize = '95% 75%',
              backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat',
              backgroundPosition = 'center')
```
